overview_description.description: FitNot wants to bring fresh and new perspective on games. Games that have exquisite art style, captivating narrative and engaging gameplay. FitNot is a statement to those who want to pursue their dreams and can't find their place yet. Don't fit with the norms, take risks and embrace your uniqueness. FitNot wants to have a positive force and impact on Egypt and the middle east gaming scene, to bring the industry in the region to new heights and establish the region as force in the industry. By leveraging our diverse culture, rooted heritage and deep history we can make games that reflect these traits to world. Games that represent the people. Games that they can identify with and be proud of. FitNot wants to cultivate a culture of collaboration and support for local talents. Games require coding, art , music and story. We want every aspect of game development to be uniquely Egyptian.
